content.title: NBC Sports NOW
content.text: On Now NBC Sports NOW Started 23 min ago What is NBC Sports NOWNBC Sports NOW is a free 24/7 streaming channel from NBC Sports offering daily sports talk shows, live sports and highlights on Peacock, the NBC Sports app, The Roku Channel, Pluto TV, Xumo and more. Daily Lineup - April is NFL Draft Month! Time (ET) Show 7 a.m. - 9 a.m. PFT Live with Mike Florio 9 a.m. - 12 p.m. The Dan Patrick Show 12 p.m. - 3 p.m. The Dan LeBatard Show with Stugotz 6 p.m. - 7 p.m. Enjoy BasketballMonday: Small Ball with Kenny BeechamTuesday, Thursday, Friday: Numbers on the BoardWednesday: T’d Up with Pierre Andresen 7 p.m. - 8 p.m. NBA on NBC Highlights Factory 8 p.m. - 9 p.m. Chris Simms Unbuttoned: Draft Rankings Plus, stay up-to-date and never miss a moment from your favorite sports with NBA on NBC Highlights Factory, Big Ten Football Highlights and Rushing the Field powering nights and weekends. Also stream live sports and fan-favorite marathons featuring the National Dog Show, SuperMotocross and Professional Darts on the FREE NBC Sports NOW FAST channel.Where Can I Watch NBC Sports NOWNBC Sports NOW can be accessed for free across most devices, including Smart TVs, streaming platforms (Peacock, The Roku Channel, Pluto TV, Xumo), smartphones, tablets and web browsers. The NBC Sports NOW channel is available across all major devices/platforms including:Peacock The Roku Channel Pluto TVXumo PlayAmazon Fire TVSamsung TV PlusFubo TV AppAmazon PrimeComcast Xfinity Stream NBC Sports NOW is available via the NBC Sports App on all major streaming devices and platforms. Simply download the app on your preferred device/platform and search the channel guide for NBC Sports NOW. Connected streaming platforms on which the NBC Sports app is available include:RokuFire TVAndroid TV / Google TVApple TVSamsung Smart TVsVizio Smart TVsxBoxxClass TVs The NBC Sports app is available on your mobile/tablet devices. Simply install the app on your preferred device and click on “Live” to watch.iPhone / iPadAndroid mobile or tablet devicesAmazon Fire tablet devices NBC Sports NOW is available on the following web sites:NBC.com Please note: NBC Sports NOW is not a live stream of the NBC linear network.
